iWatch Padel is the best application for your Apple Watch. It allows you to count the points and monitor the results of your Padel or Tennis match and see the history of the matches you have played.

You will also be able to view statistics of the points played during your match and analyze them in order to take your game to the next level.

Configure the options with which you play your match before starting it:

- Tie Break: Do you have time to play? Then you will use Tie Break. Activate it from the settings so that in case of a tie at 6 games, the Tie Break score is activated automatically.

- Golden Points: When we are a little short of time and we want to finish the match without ending up tying due to lack of time. We have the option to activate the GOLDEN POINTS. In this case, after a 40-40 the winning team will win the game directly.

- Different games per set: Are you playing a tournament? A friendly match? Don't worry, iWatch Padel allows you to adapt to any type of match. Now you can select how many games each set has and thus easily control all types of padel matches you play.

- Optional third set: Did the match last less than expected? Don't worry, you have the option to continue playing a third set and keep track of the points even if it no longer affects the overall match result.

- Activity: Do you like to monitor the calories you spend playing? You can activate the Activity option in the iWatch Padel app. When you start a match, it will automatically start a training session as well. At the end, you can see the summary in the Activity app on your Apple Watch and in your match summary.

- User-friendly: Have you ever got lost counting the score in the middle of your match? Now with iWatch Padel you don't have to worry about your memory, keep track of the score at all times. To add a point, just click on the team that scored the point and it will be added automatically. You will also be able to see the turn to serve at all times so you can focus on winning the match.

- Error-proofing: Did you make a mistake when adding a point or do you have to repeat the point again because of a questionable ball? No problem! You can easily undo the points one by one as many times as necessary.

- Efficiency: Keeps the Apple Watch screen off while you are playing to save battery life.

Very intuitive interface to make it easier for you to control your matches.

The team is always improving the application so that all you have to worry about is playing your padel game and improving your level. Can you become like the World Padel Tour players?
